apples.name: Apples (Malus domestica)
apples.description: High ethylene sensitivity and moderate producer. High humidity prevents shriveling.

bananas.name: Bananas (Musa acuminata)
bananas.description: Highly sensitive to ethylene-induced ripening. Chilling injury occurs below 12°C.

tomatoes.name: Tomatoes (Solanum lycopersicum)
tomatoes.description: Requires moderate temperature to preserve flavor volatiles without chilling damage.

leafy_greens.name: Leafy Greens (Spinach & Lettuce)
leafy_greens.description: Requires near-saturation humidity to prevent rapid moisture loss and wilting.

strawberries.name: Strawberries (Fragaria × ananassa)
strawberries.description: High susceptibility to gray mold (Botrytis cinerea). Blue light helps inhibit fungal sporulation.

potatoes.name: Potatoes (Solanum tuberosum)
potatoes.description: Keep in darkness! Light induces toxic solanine accumulation. Cold below 6°C causes sugar sweetening.

oranges.name: Oranges & Citrus
oranges.description: Non-climacteric fruit. Controlled ventilation prevents carbon dioxide and rind breakdown.

custom.name: Custom Storage Protocol
custom.description: User-defined setpoints for specific laboratory or agricultural experiments.
